Green Party of Alameda County — 2026 Candidate Questionnaire for Berkeley City Council. Transcribed from the .doc, verbatim. Eighteen numbered topics, most containing several sub-questions; each sub-question is a separate item here so they can be drafted and tracked individually.

NO DUE DATE RECORDED.

THE MOST BERKELEY-SPECIFIC FORM OF THE SET. It names Flock directly, asks whether to expand, maintain or eliminate it, and asks about NCRIC, ICE and UASI MOUs — the campaign's central issue, asked more precisely than anywhere else.

IT ALSO CARRIES THE NOVEMBER BALLOT. Section 15 lists Berkeley Measures 1 through 7, including the sales tax (Measure 2) and the public bank parcel tax (Measure 6), plus fifteen state propositions. Positions taken here are positions on the same ballot the candidate is on.

Research not yet attached.
